definitions.explanation: A reduction in interest rates, typically by a central bank as a monetary policy measure. Composed of {利|り} (interest) + {下|さ}げ (lowering).

examples.japanese: ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}{銀行|ぎんこう}→中央銀行：10173_chuuouginkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{利下|りさ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: The central bank decided on an interest rate cut.

examples.japanese: {利下|りさ}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}した→上昇する：21681_joushousuru⟧。
examples.english: Stock prices rose due to the effect of the rate cut.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦{後退|こうたい}→後退：12556_koutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な{利下|りさ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実施|じっし}される→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧だ。
examples.english: A significant rate cut is expected to be implemented to prevent an economic downturn.

notes:
USAGE:
{利下|りさ}げ is a noun often used in news and financial reporting. It can also be used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {利下|りさ}げ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to cut interest rates). The word is frequently seen in headlines about central bank policy decisions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {利下|りさ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (carry out a rate cut)
- ⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な{利下|りさ}げ (significant rate cut)
- ⟦{追加|ついか}→追加：04060_tsuika⟧{利下|りさ}げ (additional rate cut)
- {利下|りさ}げ⟦{幅|はば}→幅：03565_haba⟧ (size of the rate cut)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{利上|りあ}げ→利上げ：11987_riage⟧ is the opposite, meaning an interest rate hike.
- ⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧ means interest rate.
- ⟦{金融|きんゆう}{緩和|かんわ}→金融緩和：24263_kinyuukanwa⟧ means monetary easing, a broader policy that includes rate cuts.
